Chapter 6869: Three Hearts Fusion

Chapter 6869: Three Hearts Fusion

“Buzz.” Eventually, the hearts’ rays illuminated all of Golden Lamp.

“A spiritual manifestation?” Living beings remained lost.

“Badump...” They started hearing the faint heartbeats.

At first, they thought it was their own. Eventually, this was clearly not the case. Moreover, they heard these beats with their mind and heart, not their ears.

“It’s here.” The first immortal wanted to know who the mastermind behind this was: “Living beings, time, and space, all three make up the world’s heart.”

One heartbeat became particularly strong. Temporal streams from all timelines converged around Stygian, forming into the shape of a heart.

“That’s one.” The immortal remained patient.

However, another reached for it, releasing countless immortal laws. Unfortunately, he failed to grasp it.

“It’s not in the present.” Spectating immortals realized they were only looking at an image.

Once the attempting immortal regained his wits, the temporal heart teleported deeper into Golden Lamp, formally fusing with the heart of the living beings.

“Golden Lamp!” The immortals tried to pursue but were stopped by the power of the dao heart.

“Badump.” In another void, space layers stacked upon each other and formed a shining heart.

“The spatial heart!” One immortal used a cauldron, attempting to suck in the whole region, including the heart.

However, there were countless layers with a heart in each. The immortal gave up, unable to obtain the real one. Perhaps all of them were fake.

Sure enough, the real thing appeared in Golden Lamp, fusing with the other two.

This was an unwelcome development for the dark immortals. They had control over Stygian except for one place - Golden Lamp.

They all had a heart devil that turned them toward the darkness. The light there could destroy the heart devil, resulting in several terrible consequences.

Their dao heart would be exposed again, causing a struggle between goodness and evil. This would destroy their cultivation.

“The world’s heart.” The first immortal to spot it chose to do nothing.

Mang and Zhao Dachui had tried before to no avail. Thus, it was wiser to wait for someone to take it out.

“Badump.” Boundless life force erupted after the fusion.

“Incredible.” Everyone in Golden Lamp couldn’t believe it.

This life force continued to spread throughout Stygian. This was akin to feeling water vapor wafting in the air while trekking through a desert. This meant an oasis or a spring was not far away.
